title: Consistency Trajectory Models: Learning Probability Flow ODE Trajectory of Diffusion
tldr_zh: 学 PF-ODE 任意时刻→任意时刻跳跃并兼得 score，加 DSM+GAN 后一步 FID 1.98/1.73（CIFAR-10）、1.92（ImageNet-64）。
tldr_en: CTM learns anytime-to-anytime PF-ODE jumps plus the score in one network; with DSM and GAN losses it reaches one-step FID 1.73 (CIFAR-10 cond.) and 1.92 (ImageNet-64).
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 uncond FID 1.98 (1 NFE) / 1.87 (2 NFE), NLL 2.43 (Table 1)
ImageNet-64 FID 1.92 (1 NFE) / 1.73 (2 NFE), Rec 0.57 vs CD 0.63 (Table 2)
CD retrained by authors FID 10.53 vs official 3.55 (Table 1)
CTM without pretrained DM FID 2.39 (1 NFE) (Table 1)
Training 100K iters CIFAR-10, 30K iters ImageNet-64 (Sec. 5.1, Table 4)
Theorem 8: TV error of N-step gamma-sampling O(sum sqrt(t_n - sqrt(1-gamma^2) t_{n+1}))
Prop. 6: optimal CTM jump is bi-Lipschitz with constants exp(±L_phi (t-s))
